title: Opening: name, place and library collection
summary: Kelly gives his name (E.T. Kelly, Edward Timothy) and the Jackson, Mississippi address; the interviewer explains the library collection.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Why don't we get your right name?
Well, actually my name is E.T. Kelly. And I acquired the Tim because my dad told me that was what the T in my name is. It means to be E Timothy Kelly.
And you never tell anybody what the E stands for?
We're at 455 Roxbury Road in Jackson, Mississippi. And we're with Mr. Howard Jones, one of my favorite trombone players, and Mr. Dick Hammond.
I work in the library there. I don't know if I told you, but we have a big collection there. Including Jack Teagarden talking about you on the stage.
Oh, well, that's nice. I had no idea of that.

Well, Jack is one of the first people I think who ever told me. Anyway, today is December the... Third? The third, 1978. And this is your home, of course. Just to ask you some standard questions, when were you born and where?
